settings.heading: Are urine and saliva drug test kits accurate?
settings.text:
Urine and saliva drug test kits can provide accurate results, especially when used correctly and in line with the manufacturer’s guidelines.

Read our full article of urine and saliva drug testing here.

settings.heading: Are urine drug test kits more accurate than saliva testing?
settings.text:
Urine drug test kits can be more accurate than saliva testing because they generally have a longer detection window for certain substances compared to saliva testing.

However, both drug testing methods are accurate depending on the intended detection window the tester would like to know.

settings.heading: Apart from urine and saliva, are there other ways to test for drugs?
settings.text:
Hair follicle testing and blood testing are other forms of screening drugs. These methods are usually more tedious and expensive compared to the convenience of saliva and urine testing and tend to have a longer detection window.

These methods are usually conducted in professional laboratories and are considered more invasive than their urine and saliva counterparts.

settings.heading: Do false results happen in drug test kits?
settings.text:
False results can happen in drug test kits and can be caused by a number of different factors, including the quality of the test kit, specimen collection and handling, external contaminations, and individual factors such as age, gender, diet or any underlying health condition.

If you suspect that your drug test kit is producing a false result, a confirmatory test will need to be administered to ensure the right results.

settings.heading: How long can drugs be detected using these testing kits?
settings.text: Drugs can be detected using saliva drug test kits usually up to 48 hours after the last use, while urine test kits can detect drug metabolites up to six weeks after the last use depending on a number of factors such as the type of drug, frequency of use and individual factors like metabolic rate, age, gender, hydration and more.

Versatile testing with urine and saliva drug test kits

The DrugSense collection includes both urine and saliva drug test kits, each offering unique benefits to meet various testing needs.

Urine drug test kits are ideal for detecting drugs over a longer time frame. Because of this, they are a top choice for pre-employment and routine workplace testing. They effectively screen for a broad range of illicit drugs in workplace settings.

Saliva drug test kits are best for detecting recent drug use over a short timeframe. This makes them ideal for on-the-spot testing like roadside checks or random workplace screenings.

Drug test kits that are efficient and easy to use

Both screening tools deliver results in minutes and are designed for ease of use, providing reliable solutions for diverse testing scenarios. With clear instructions, these kits allow for quick sample collection and testing. 

Negative results are typically indicated by the presence of visible lines in the test window, while a positive result is shown by the absence of specific test lines. This straightforward interpretation ensures reliable results without the need for specialised training, making our kits suitable for workplaces, clinics, and personal use.

DrugSense testing kits from Andatech offer comprehensive testing of up to 15 different drugs in a single kit. Drugs screened include common illicit drugs such as THC (cannabis), amphetamines, opiates, cocaine, benzodiazepines, alcohol and more.

Australian Standard compliance for DrugSense drug test kits

DrugSense drug test kits are rigorously designed to meet Australian/New Zealand Standards — AS/NZS 4760 for oral drug test kits and AS/NZS 4308 for urine drug test kits. These standards ensure reliable and accurate results by specifying guidelines for sample collection and drug cut-off levels in oral fluid and urine specimens.

Compliance with these standards guarantees the precision and reliability of our screening tools, making them ideal for professional settings like workplaces and roadside testing. Independent verification further confirms that selected DrugSense drug test kits adhere to AS/NZS cut-off levels, enhancing sensitivity and accuracy in detecting drug metabolites. This reflects our commitment to delivering high-quality, trustworthy testing solutions.

Additionally, we do our best to ensure our drug test kits’ compliance to the latest standards. For example, the DrugSense DSU6 urine dip card is compliant to the latest AS/NZS 4308:2023 for urine drug testing. For oral fluid drug testing, the DrugSense DSO8 Plus has been verified to the latest AS/NZS 4760:2019.
